name: Maramureș
summary: Maramureș is a geographical and ethno-cultural region located on the territory of Romania and Ukraine, consisting of the Maramureș Depression, located on the upper course of the Tisa valley, and the slopes of the mountains that surround it: the Oaș, Gutâi, Țibleș, and Rodna mountains to the west and south, and the Maramureș mountains to the east and north.
